channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: TRE-SP multa candidato em R$ 7,5 mil por impulsionar propaganda negativa contra Lula e Haddad
item.description: The São Paulo Regional Electoral Court (TRE-SP) fined federal deputy candidate Luiz Camargo (Novo) R$ 7,500 for boosting a video with irregular negative propaganda. The content compared Lula's government to Nicolás Maduro's, criticized Fernando Haddad, the Workers' Party (PT), and electronic voting machines.

item.title: Reginaldo Lopes será presidente da comissão da “taxa das blusinhas”
item.description: Chamber President Hugo Motta appointed Deputy Reginaldo Lopes (PT-MG) to chair the joint committee analyzing the MP that eliminates the 'blusinhas tax'. The committee will be installed on September 1st, following an agreement between Lula, Alcolumbre, and Motta. The measure must be approved by September 8th to remain valid.

item.title: Alcolumbre promete votar minerais críticos e Redata na próxima semana
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre announced he will schedule the critical minerals bill and the Data Center Infrastructure Act (Redata) for next week, following a meeting with Lula and Hugo Motta. Both proposals, stalled in the Senate, will be prioritized pending potential amendments, while the PEC to end the 6×1 workday continues in the CCJ.

item.title: Lula pede regulação de terras raras após avanço de mineradora dos EUA
item.description: President Lula (PT) called for regulation of rare earth exploration in Brazil, stating foreign companies, including a US miner, are advancing on these strategic resources without clear rules. The statement followed a meeting with the presidents of the Senate and the Chamber of Deputies.

item.title: Petistas pedem investigação da relação entre escritório de Flávio Bolsonaro e alvo da operação do INSS
item.description: PT deputies Alencar Santana and Rogério Correia filed a crime report with the Federal Police requesting an investigation into possible connections between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's law office and individuals under investigation in the INSS fraud operation. The move by the PT lawmakers aims to probe alleged links between the senator and the benefit-fraud scheme.

item.title: TSE julga na próxima semana ação sobre vídeo deepfake de Bolsonaro
item.description: Brazil's Superior Electoral Court (TSE) will hold an in-person hearing next week to judge a case challenging a deepfake video of former president Jair Bolsonaro shown at the PL convention. Considered one of the key tests on artificial intelligence in the 2026 elections, the ruling is expected to set parameters for synthetic content in campaigns. Flávio Bolsonaro's defense argues the video does not constitute a prohibited deepfake, while the Brazil of Hope Federation (PT, PCdoB, PV) contends the ban applies regardless of disclosure of the technology.

item.title: Hugo Motta indica presidente da comissão da MP da Taxa das Blusinhas
item.description: Hugo Motta appointed Reginaldo Lopes (PT-MG) as head of the joint committee reviewing the MP ending the so-called 'blusinhas tax'. The announcement followed a meeting with Lula and Davi Alcolumbre, who scheduled voting for next week. The MP also suspends a 20% fee on international purchases up to US$ 50.

item.title: Pacto entre Lula, Motta e Alcolumbre tem eleições no radar, promessas de apoio e união contra Flávio
item.description: Lula signed a pact with Chamber President Hugo Motta and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to advance popular measures like ending the 6x1 workweek and tax breaks for data centers before elections. The deal includes mutual support: Lula backs their 2027 reelection as House and Senate leaders, while they work for Lula's reelection, aiming for a first-round victory.

item.title: A nova pesquisa AtlasIntel sobre a disputa entre Haddad e Tarcísio em São Paulo
item.description: New AtlasIntel poll on São Paulo gubernatorial race to be released Tuesday with 1,800 interviews. Previous Quaest poll showed Tarcísio de Freitas leading with 40% versus 27% for Fernando Haddad in first round.

item.title: Campanha de Lula diz que tarifa zero é complexa, mas governo olha proposta ‘com carinho’
item.description: Lula's campaign is considering zero-fare public transportation in a potential fourth term, while acknowledging the operational and fiscal complexity of the measure. The government is studying alternative funding sources, such as taxing individual transport externalities, restructuring transit vouchers, and allocating Cide fuel tax resources.

item.title: Em Alagoas, Flávio defende Gaspar como vice: “Nordeste no centro do poder”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro announced Alfredo Gaspar as his running mate, emphasizing the Northeast's role in decision-making. The choice aims to expand support in a region where Lula leads polls. Flávio highlighted promises of development, infrastructure, and jobs for the Northeast.

item.title: Lula diz que tem 'muita gente estrangeira' comprando minerais críticos do Brasil antes de país regulamentar setor
item.description: President Lula stated that foreigners are purchasing critical minerals from Brazil without regulation, advocating for the approval of the national policy for critical minerals in the Senate. The project, already approved in the Chamber, creates legislation to attract national investments in the sector with a fund of R$5 billion. Lula emphasized the importance of defining that mineral wealth belongs to the country and not to individuals or foreigners.

item.title: TRE-SP multa candidato por impulsionar propaganda contra Lula e Haddad
item.description: The TRE-SP fined federal deputy candidate Luiz Camargo (Novo) R$7,500 for paid promotion of a video attacking Lula, Haddad, and the PT. The content included comparisons with Venezuela and insinuations of fraud in electronic voting. The candidate may appeal to the TSE.

item.title: Livro escancara relação entre a prática da misoginia e o avanço da extrema-direita no país
item.description: The book 'Machosfera – When Misogyny Becomes Politics' by researcher Bruna Camilo, launched in Brasília, reveals how misogyny evolved from an individual stance to an organized political strategy, particularly linked to the rise of the far-right and Jair Bolsonaro's 2018 campaign. The work maps hate networks amplified by social media and disinformation, denouncing the normalization of misogynist discourse in public and political life.

item.title: Lula brinca com Hugo Motta e Davi Alcolumbre: ‘Juntos para sempre’
item.description: President Lula joked with congressional leaders about governing 'forever together' during a meeting to align votes on government priorities. Key items include the measure ending the 'blusinhas tax' to be voted next week, along with critical minerals and data center projects. Security and 6x1 work schedule PECs were also discussed. Despite recent tensions, Lula reconciled with Motta and Alcolumbre, even endorsing Motta's father's Senate campaign.

item.title: US Open: Wild é eliminado no quali e Brasil fica sem tenistas no simples
item.description: Thiago Wild was eliminated in the US Open qualifying draw, leaving Brazil without representatives in the singles draw. With João Fonseca's withdrawal due to injury, Brazil will only be represented in the doubles events. Wild lost to Mackenzie McDonald 6-4 6-4 in 1h22.

item.title: Governo é contra a exploração de terras raras em Goiás por empresa americana e avalia como rever negócio
item.description: The federal government opposes the exploitation of rare earth minerals in northern Goiás by a U.S. company, questioning the legality of the deal signed between USA Rare Earth and mineradora Serra Verde. The agreement, which includes sending 100% of initial production to the U.S., depends on shareholder approval and the upcoming National Policy on Critical Minerals, still pending senate approval. The government is considering revising the deal or taking legal action, emphasizing the priority of developing the domestic strategic mineral supply chain.

item.title: Empresário tenta se vacinar contra ação da PF antes de agenda com Flávio
item.description: Entrepreneur and federal deputy candidate Renato Araújo (PL-RJ), an ally of Flávio Bolsonaro, posted a video on social media anticipating a possible Federal Police operation against him before his scheduled event with Flávio in Angra dos Reis. He accused the PF of using search warrants to silence opponents, referencing similar cases involving Jair Bolsonaro. On August 13, a construction company linked to Araújo was raided over suspected fraud in public school construction projects.

item.title: Documentário BBC: O outro lado da guerra das facções em El Salvador
item.description: The BBC documentary explores El Salvador's state of exception under Nayib Bukele, which reduced violence but increased imprisonment rates. Brazilian candidates like Renan Santos, Romeu Zema, and Ronaldo Caiado cite the strategy as a reference, fueling public safety debates.

item.title: Fila do INSS cai 59% em agosto e atinge menor nível desde 2023, diz governo
item.description: The queue for INSS benefit claims dropped 59% between January and August 2026, reaching 1.28 million requests, the lowest level since 2023. The decline was driven by an 86% reduction in claims delayed over 45 days and by process digitalization and optimization. Despite progress, the queue still exceeds 1 million requests, with approximately 1.3 million new claims per month.

item.title: SP sanciona lei para absorver funcionários da CPTM após concessões
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas signed a law allowing the state government to absorb CPTM employees into other public administration agencies or entities.

item.title: Tragédia no Nepal e Tibete: Itamaraty divulga telefones de apoio para brasileiros
item.description: Itamaraty released emergency contact numbers to assist Brazilian citizens in Nepal and Tibet following an earthquake that triggered landslides and floods. The government is monitoring the situation through embassies in Kathmandu and Beijing, with no Brazilian nationals identified among the victims or missing so far. President Lula expressed sympathy for affected families and local authorities.

item.title: Tarcísio sai em defesa de Flávio Bolsonaro no caso Dark Horse: 'Acredito que ele não deve nada'
item.description: São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas defended Flávio Bolsonaro regarding the 'Dark Horse' case, stating he believes he owes nothing. The statement was made during a live interview promoted by Veja magazine.

item.title: O afago de Lula a Motta e Alcolumbre às vésperas de esforço concentrado do Congresso
item.description: President Lula publicly praised the heads of the Chamber, Hugo Motta, and the Senate, Davi Alcolumbre, after a joint lunch, highlighting their willingness to put important topics on the agenda. The statements come on the eve of Congress's final concentrated-effort week before the elections, a period in which priority Planalto matters, such as the provisional measure ending the blusinha tax and the constitutional amendment ending the 6x1 work schedule, may move forward.

item.title: Campanha de Lula aciona TSE contra Renan e Caiado por falas em debate
item.description: Lula's campaign filed a complaint with the TSE against Renan Santos and Ronaldo Caiado over statements made during the Band debate. The president did not attend the event. The defense requests the removal of social media posts.

item.title: Alcolumbre diz que CCJ deve votar PEC da Segurança e 6x1 na próxima semana
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre stated that the CCJ should vote next week on the Public Security PEC and the end of the 6x1 work schedule, following a lunch with Lula and Hugo Motta at the Alvorada Palace to discuss government priorities. Rapporteurs Omar Aziz (6x1 PEC) and Rogério Carvalho (Public Security PEC) are drafting their reports, with presentation expected on Wednesday. The progress marks a truce between Lula and Alcolumbre after tensions caused by the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias's nomination to the STF.

item.title: Tarcísio diz ser pragmático e ter “linha aderente” ao “bolsonarismo”
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas described himself as pragmatic and aligned with bolsonarismo, emphasizing health, education, bureaucracy reduction, and greater private sector participation. He endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential bid.

item.title: Grupo simula enforcamento de boneco “petista” na Festa do Peão de Barretos
item.description: During the Barretos Rodeo Festival, a group simulated the hanging and beating of a doll identified as 'Petista' (PT supporter), with phrases like 'Fora Lula' and 'Petista fdp', highlighting the political tone of the event. President Lula was heckled during a Gusttavo Lima concert, and the event featured strong presence of right-wing politicians such as Flávio Bolsonaro, Tarcísio de Freitas, and Nikolas Ferreira, who used the stage to connect with the agribusiness audience.

item.title: Lula almoça com Alcolumbre e Motta e negocia fim de 6x1 e MP das blusinhas
item.description: Lula lunches with Alcolumbre and Motta to negotiate the end of the 6x1 scale and the MP of the blusinhas. The meeting aims to advance labor and tax reforms.

item.title: O amigo de Lulinha que se deu bem no governo
item.description: The report reveals that Marcelo Checon, a close friend of Lulinha, saw his events company's revenue jump from R$197,000 to R$63 million in federal government contracts after Lula took office. The rise coincided with the strengthening of their relationship, including international trips together, raising suspicions of influence peddling among Brasília's business circles.

item.title: Crusoé: Uma prova de que Lula sentiu o impacto do caso Lulinha
item.description: A Crusoé report indicates that President Lula (PT) is preparing a narrative shift to contain damage to his image following leaks involving his son Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, who is under investigation for influence peddling. Until now, Lula has maintained that only his son 'knows the truth' about the case. The move shows that the Palácio felt the political impact of the scandal.

item.title: TRE do RN vê 'de Lula' como apoio político e libera uso a candidatos do PT
item.description: The TRE of Rio Grande do Norte unanimously authorized the use of the names "Cadu de Lula" and "Samanda de Lula" on electronic ballots for the state government and Senate elections. The justices ruled that the preposition "de" disconnects a direct relationship of explicit political support.

item.title: Eleições: CEBDS entrega carta a presidenciáveis e pede política de Estado para agenda verde
item.description: The Brazilian Business Council for Sustainable Development (CEBDS), which brings together more than 110 large companies representing about one third of the GDP, will deliver a letter to 2026 presidential candidates this Wednesday (26) during the Sustainable Congress in Rio de Janeiro. The document calls for the adoption of a state policy focused on the green agenda, emphasizing environmental sustainability. The initiative aims to influence the electoral debate and commit candidates to long-term environmental goals.

item.title: 'Inimaginável' um brasileiro se colocar contra a sua pátria, diz Caiado sobre família Bolsonaro
item.description: PSD presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado called the Bolsonaro family's stance against Brazil in the tariff dispute with the US 'unimaginable'. The Goiás governor condemned their behavior during a sabatina with CBN, O Globo, and Valor Econômico.

item.title: Prevenção à violência infantil não é prioridade de candidatos, diz Unicef
item.description: According to Unicef, most of the five leading presidential candidates in 2026 include proposals to prevent violence against children, but prioritize punitive and repressive actions such as increased penalties, more policing, and lowering the age of criminal responsibility, rather than preventive strategies. Lula stands out for emphasizing prevention, while Flávio Bolsonaro, Zema, and Caiado advocate tougher measures, and Renan Santos does not explicitly address the issue.

item.title: Ex-chefe da FAB: 8 de Janeiro foi fruto de “descrédito das urnas”
item.description: The former commander of the Brazilian Air Force, Carlos de Almeida Baptista Jr., stated that the January 8, 2023 events were the result of a prior discrediting of electronic voting machines and institutional tensions. He emphasized that the electoral crisis preceded the event, fueling doubts about the legitimacy of the electoral process. Baptista gave an exclusive interview to O Antagonista.

item.title: Produtora promete entregar contas de Dark Horse à PF
item.description: Producer Karina Gama of 'Dark Horse' promised the Federal Police to deliver all requested materials by Friday to aid investigations. In related news, former Reag executive João Carlos Mansur submitted a plea deal proposal to the Attorney General's office, alleging embezzlement and implicating Daniel Vorcaro. The PF is also pursuing an appeal against Supreme Court minister André Mendonça's ruling on INSS case data access.

item.title: Lula reage e vai ao TSE contra Renan Santos e Caiado por ataques em debate
item.description: summary in 2-3 sentences

item.title: Indexa/Broadcast: Lula marca 46% contra 41% de Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno
item.description: An Indexa/Broadcast poll shows President Lula leading the first round with 39% versus 34% for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). In a runoff, Lula would beat Flávio 46% to 41%, and holds a 6- to 12-point lead over Caiado, Zema, and Renan Santos. The survey interviewed 2,000 voters with a margin of error of 2.2 percentage points.

item.title: Pesquisa Indexa/Broadcast: 51% afirmam que Lula não merece novo mandato em 2026
item.description: Indexa/Broadcast poll reveals 51% of voters disapprove of Lula's management, with 50% saying he does not deserve a new term in 2026. Approval stands at 46%, while disapproval reaches 50%. The survey was released on Tuesday, June 17, 2025.

item.title: Indexa/Broadcast: Renan Santos vence Lula na região Sul do Brasil
item.description: Renan Santos leads with 48% of voting intentions in the South region, surpassing Lula (33%) in a potential runoff, according to an Indexa/Broadcast poll released on March 26. The survey shows the candidate from the Missão à Presidência party gaining an advantage in the southern region.

item.title: Dólar sobe e Ibovespa dispara, puxados pela inflação no Brasil e nos EUA
item.description: The dollar rose 0.40% against the real, trading at R$5.16, while the Ibovespa opened higher, driven by inflation data released in both the US and Brazil. US inflation, measured by the PCE, accelerated to 3.7% annually, exceeding forecasts and maintaining pressure on Fed monetary policy. In Brazil, the IPCA-15 fell 0.40% in August, surpassing expectations and reinforcing the outlook for a Selic rate cut at the next Copom meeting.

item.title: Após faltar na Band, Zema promete comparecer ao próximo debate
item.description: After missing the debate hosted by Band, former governor Romeu Zema (Novo) promised to attend the next one, scheduled for September 14th. His campaign justified the absence due to the no-shows of Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL).

item.title: Cheiro de recessão no ar (por Hubert Alquéres)
item.description: The article argues that Brazil's economic outlook shows clear recession signs, disconnected from Lula's optimistic campaign slogan. It cites cases like Casas Bahia's bankruptcy filing, record household debt (82%), and Armínio Fraga's comparison to the pre-Dilma crisis, projecting low growth for 2027. The text criticizes the insufficiency of government consumption incentive and debt renegotiation policies to contain fiscal deterioration and foreign capital flight.

item.title: Tarcísio de Freitas participa de sabatina de VEJA nesta quarta-feira
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas takes part in a VEJA interview on Wednesday as part of its special 2026 election coverage. Conducted by Marcela Rahal, Robson Bonin, and José Benedito, the interview will be live-streamed at 2 PM. Tarcísio runs for reelection against former minister Fernando Haddad (PT), also featured in the series.

item.title: Em cenário de 1º turno, Lula tem 39%, e Flávio Bolsonaro, 34%, mostra pesquisa Indexa/Broadcast
item.description: A survey by Indexa Pesquisas, commissioned by Broadcast, shows President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading first-round polling intentions in the 2026 elections with 39%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 34%. The 5-point gap indicates a tight race between the two most-mentioned candidates.

item.title: Com Lula ou Flávio, economistas mantêm ceticismo sobre ajuste fiscal
item.description: Economists remain skeptical about fiscal adjustment under both Lula and Flávio, with Brazil's public debt likely to keep rising regardless of who wins the 2026 presidential election.

item.title: No 2º turno, Lula lidera com 46% ante 41% de Flávio Bolsonaro, aponta pesquisa Indexa/Broadcast
item.description: A survey by Indexa Pesquisas, commissioned by Broadcast, shows that in the runoff, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leads with 46% of voting intentions, against 41% for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The poll was released on Wednesday, the 26th.

item.title: Real Madrid x Real Sociedad: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Real Madrid hosts Real Sociedad on Wednesday, 26, at 16:00 (Brasília time), at the Santiago Bernabéu, in a postponed first-round La Liga 2026/27 match, featuring José Mourinho's return as manager. The team seeks its second consecutive win after a dramatic victory over Espanyol, where Carlos Espí scored the decisive goal. Endrick remains out due to tendinitis, while Real Sociedad responds to their loss against Real Betis.

item.title: Flávio terceiriza prestação de contas de Dark Horse, e repasse de fundo dos EUA segue sem detalhes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, PL presidential candidate, outsourced the accounting of Dark Horse movie funding to the producer Go Up Entertainment without disclosing details about the US fund Havengate that facilitated the payments, failing to uphold his transparency commitment.
